title: Octopuses Have 3 Hearts and Blue Blood
description:
An octopus has three hearts and blue, copper-based blood, and its main heart stops when it swims.
Follow MarketOpsTips for a surprising fact every evening.

#facts #octopus #shorts

beats.say: An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
Two hearts pump blood through the gills.
The third heart pumps blood to the rest of the body.
Their blood is copper-based, and that's what makes it blue.
Here's the strange part. The main heart stops while the octopus swims.
So octopuses prefer to crawl instead.
Would you rather have three hearts, or just one?
